paragraphs: FASTER sells fleet management and asset maintenance software for organizations that keep vehicles and equipment running. Its customers manage university fleets, transit agencies, city vehicles, and utility trucks.

The software automates preventive maintenance scheduling, tracks parts in real time, and moves work orders through the shop. Maintenance and labor tracking are organized around the work order process flow. Asset management runs from acquisition planning through disposal. Reporting covers total cost of ownership, downtime, and utilization by vehicle, department, or fleet.

The company says more than 400 organizations manage over one million assets on it across North America. Those customers include city governments, universities, utilities, public works departments, and private fleet operators in construction, energy, and logistics. FASTER dates the software back more than forty years. It is part of Transit Technologies. The company describes itself as US based, with product, engineering, and support teams in the United States.
